en_raw: Kirby and the World Beyond just got announced, so I went through the trailer frame by frame
multiple times to try and find every single hidden detail I could.
Okay, if you're a real one, you knew this was Kirby from the very first frame.
The Donut Hills and the Windmill Tree are fixtures of Dreamland at this point.
Also, knowing this is a 3D and open world or at least open area style of game, seeing
the roads that would usually be the limitation of Kirby's movement in every game prior
to Forgotten Land from this wide of a view is a real treat, especially since
we spend no time in Dreamland during Forgotten Land as all the Dreamland scenes are relegated
to cutscenes.
The Giant Stack Donut Hills are really notable in this shot of course, and knowing the game's
open nature, maybe Kirby can actually get to the top of this structure for some kind
of reward.
The next shot has the Windmill Trees we've seen dabbing in older games, but there's
also something that appears to be a platform or deck protruding out from the tree trunk,
so I believe this may be a way to enter or interact with the Windmill Trees
in some way, which is pretty neat because they were basically a background item in
other Kirby games.
But more interesting to me is the winding path in the background, as its intentional layout
makes it appear to be leading to something important, or at least leading to something
with intention.
You can kind of make out what seems to be a cave, but we get a better look at that
later.
